key_insight: The proposed framework enhances PIV data by utilizing unlabelled probe data to improve flow estimation accuracy and temporal consistency.
engineering_relevance: This method is crucial for advancing pressure field reconstruction in aerodynamics applications with limited data acquisition.
method: Enrich original PIV dataset using an advection model.
Employ semi-supervised learning to leverage unlabelled probe data.
Train neural networks to predict temporal coefficients and their derivatives.
evidence_signal: The approach significantly improves accuracy and temporal smoothness in velocity reconstruction based on synthetic and experimental data.
watch_item: The effectiveness heavily relies on the assumptions of the advection model and the quality of unlabelled probe data.
paper_title: Data-efficient semi-supervised learning for flow estimation using unlabelled probe data
